properties.history_en: Seat of the rock-hewn churches of the Zagwe period (GHA III p.573).

properties.history_en: Birthplace of the Prophet Muhammad (GHA III p.31); holy city under the Ottomans (GHA V p.138).

properties.history_en: National capital of Ethiopia, in the centre of the country (LOC Ethiopia country study).
